result.title: Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver
result.summary: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

AI.brief_summary: 论文形式化定义了「空承诺」——即智能体承诺在当前轮之后执行某动作，但其工具或运行时配置根本无力兑现；并给出三类失败类型、锚定条件与响应层结果分类，最后提出一套逐项增加持久化能力的五档评测协议。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 的「停止决策」和运行时能力边界刻画可能相关：其「承诺—可兑现能力」的形式化或可迁移到 latent 推理轨迹的停止/继续承诺，以及区分「模型没算到」与「架构上无法再算」的诊断；但属纯文本智能体设定，需核查能否对应视觉证据筛选与状态可用性问题。
